definition: to leave someone or something permanently or stop doing something
example: They had to abandon the plan because it was too expensive.
exampleTranslation: Mereka harus membatalkan rencana itu karena terlalu mahal.
usage: Often used for plans, projects, or places.

definition: the skill or power to do something
example: She has the ability to explain difficult ideas clearly.
exampleTranslation: Dia punya kemampuan untuk menjelaskan gagasan sulit dengan jelas.
usage: Usually followed by to + verb.

definition: having the skill, power, or opportunity to do something
example: Will you be able to join us tomorrow?
exampleTranslation: Apakah kamu bisa bergabung dengan kami besok?
usage: Use be able to for ability in different tenses.

definition: in or to a foreign country
example: He hopes to study abroad next year.
exampleTranslation: Dia berharap kuliah di luar negeri tahun depan.
usage: Say go abroad, live abroad, or study abroad.

definition: the fact of not being present
example: Her absence was noticed by everyone.
exampleTranslation: Ketidakhadirannya disadari semua orang.
usage: Common in school and workplace contexts.

definition: complete and not limited in any way
example: I need absolute silence to concentrate.
exampleTranslation: Aku membutuhkan keheningan total untuk berkonsentrasi.
usage: Absolute certainty means complete certainty.

definition: completely; used to strongly agree
example: I absolutely agree with your decision.
exampleTranslation: Aku sangat setuju dengan keputusanmu.
usage: Can be used alone to mean 'yes, definitely'.

definition: related to education, schools, or scholarly study
example: The course focuses on academic writing.
exampleTranslation: Kursus itu berfokus pada penulisan akademis.
usage: Academic vocabulary is common in essays and lectures.

definition: to agree to take or receive something
example: She accepted the job offer immediately.
exampleTranslation: Dia langsung menerima tawaran pekerjaan itu.
usage: Accept an offer, invitation, or responsibility.

definition: the right or opportunity to use or reach something
example: Students can access the materials online.
exampleTranslation: Siswa dapat mengakses materi itu secara daring.
usage: Access is usually uncountable as a noun.

definition: an unexpected event that causes damage or injury
example: He was late because of a traffic accident.
exampleTranslation: Dia terlambat karena kecelakaan lalu lintas.
usage: By accident means unintentionally.

definition: to go somewhere with someone
example: Would you like me to accompany you to the station?
exampleTranslation: Mau aku temani kamu ke stasiun?
usage: Accompany is more formal than go with.

definition: to succeed in doing or completing something
example: You can accomplish a lot with consistent practice.
exampleTranslation: Kamu bisa mencapai banyak hal dengan latihan yang konsisten.
usage: Accomplish a task, goal, or mission.

definition: correct and free from mistakes
example: Make sure the information is accurate.
exampleTranslation: Pastikan informasinya akurat.
usage: Accurate information; accurate measurement.

definition: to succeed in reaching a goal
example: She worked hard to achieve her goals.
exampleTranslation: Dia bekerja keras untuk mencapai tujuannya.
usage: Achieve a goal, result, or success.

definition: something important that you succeed in doing
example: Graduating was a major achievement for him.
exampleTranslation: Lulus merupakan pencapaian besar baginya.
usage: A sense of achievement is the feeling of success.

definition: to accept or admit that something is true
example: He acknowledged that he had made a mistake.
exampleTranslation: Dia mengakui bahwa dia telah melakukan kesalahan.
usage: Acknowledge a mistake, fact, or contribution.

definition: to get or gain something through effort or experience
example: Children acquire language through interaction.
exampleTranslation: Anak-anak memperoleh bahasa melalui interaksi.
usage: Acquire knowledge, skills, or a habit.

definition: real or existing in fact
example: The actual cost was lower than expected.
exampleTranslation: Biaya sebenarnya lebih rendah dari perkiraan.

definition: used to emphasize what is true or correct
example: I actually enjoyed the lecture.
exampleTranslation: Sebenarnya aku menikmati kuliah itu.

definition: to change something to suit a new situation
example: It took me a while to adapt to the new schedule.
exampleTranslation: Butuh waktu bagiku untuk beradaptasi dengan jadwal baru.
usage: Adapt to a situation; adapt something for a purpose.

definition: extra or added
example: We need additional information.
exampleTranslation: Kami membutuhkan informasi tambahan.

definition: to deal with a problem or speak to someone
example: We need to address this issue soon.
exampleTranslation: Kita perlu menangani masalah ini segera.

definition: enough or satisfactory for a particular purpose
example: We have adequate time to finish the project.
exampleTranslation: Kita punya cukup waktu untuk menyelesaikan proyek ini.
usage: Adequate for a need or purpose.

definition: to respect someone or something because of their qualities
example: I really admire how calmly she handles pressure.
exampleTranslation: Aku sangat mengagumi caranya menghadapi tekanan dengan tenang.

definition: to agree that something is true, especially unwillingly
example: He admitted that he had forgotten the appointment.
exampleTranslation: Dia mengakui bahwa dia lupa janji itu.

definition: to take and use an idea, method, or practice
example: The team adopted a different approach.
exampleTranslation: Tim itu menerapkan pendekatan yang berbeda.

definition: progress or development; to move forward
example: Technology continues to advance rapidly.
exampleTranslation: Teknologi terus berkembang dengan cepat.

definition: something that makes a situation better for you
example: Speaking two languages is a real advantage.
exampleTranslation: Menguasai dua bahasa merupakan keuntungan nyata.

definition: an opinion about what someone should do
example: Can I ask you for some advice?
exampleTranslation: Boleh aku minta saran darimu?

definition: an event or matter, especially one that is important
example: It's a private affair.
exampleTranslation: Itu urusan pribadi.

definition: to cause a change in someone or something
example: Lack of sleep can affect your concentration.
exampleTranslation: Kurang tidur dapat memengaruhi konsentrasimu.

definition: to have enough money or time for something
example: I can't afford to buy a new laptop right now.
exampleTranslation: Aku belum mampu membeli laptop baru sekarang.

definition: a result that you hope to achieve
example: My main aim is to speak more naturally.
exampleTranslation: Tujuan utamaku adalah berbicara lebih alami.

definition: to let someone do something
example: My schedule doesn't allow me to stay late.
exampleTranslation: Jadwalku tidak memungkinkan aku untuk tinggal lebih lama.

definition: not completely or not quite
example: I've almost finished the assignment.
exampleTranslation: Aku hampir menyelesaikan tugas itu.

definition: without other people
example: I prefer to work alone when I need to focus.
exampleTranslation: Aku lebih suka bekerja sendiri saat perlu fokus.

definition: to change something, usually slightly
example: We had to alter our plans at the last minute.
exampleTranslation: Kami harus mengubah rencana pada saat terakhir.

definition: used to introduce a contrast
example: Although it was raining, we still went out.
exampleTranslation: Meskipun hujan, kami tetap pergi keluar.

definition: to surprise someone very much
example: Her progress continues to amaze me.
exampleTranslation: Perkembangannya terus membuatku takjub.

definition: determined to be successful or achieve something
example: She's ambitious but realistic about her goals.
exampleTranslation: Dia ambisius tetapi realistis tentang tujuannya.

definition: a quantity of something
example: A large amount of work remains.
exampleTranslation: Masih ada banyak pekerjaan yang tersisa.

definition: to examine something carefully to understand it
example: Let's analyse the results before making a decision.
exampleTranslation: Mari analisis hasilnya sebelum mengambil keputusan.

definition: to make information publicly known
example: They will announce the results tomorrow.
exampleTranslation: Mereka akan mengumumkan hasilnya besok.

definition: to make someone slightly angry
example: It annoys me when people interrupt.
exampleTranslation: Aku kesal ketika orang menyela.

definition: happening once every year
example: The company holds an annual meeting.
exampleTranslation: Perusahaan itu mengadakan rapat tahunan.

definition: worried or nervous about something
example: I felt anxious before the interview.
exampleTranslation: Aku merasa cemas sebelum wawancara.

definition: to say that you are sorry for doing something wrong
example: You should apologize for what you said.
exampleTranslation: Kamu sebaiknya meminta maaf atas ucapanmu.

definition: easy to see or understand
example: It soon became apparent that we needed help.
exampleTranslation: Tak lama kemudian terlihat jelas bahwa kami membutuhkan bantuan.

definition: the quality of being attractive; to make a serious request
example: The idea has strong appeal for young learners.
exampleTranslation: Gagasan itu sangat menarik bagi pelajar muda.

definition: to become visible or seem to be a certain way
example: A new message appeared on my screen.
exampleTranslation: Pesan baru muncul di layarku.

definition: to make a formal request or use an idea in practice
example: I'm going to apply for the position.
exampleTranslation: Aku akan melamar posisi itu.

definition: a way of dealing with something; to come closer
example: We need a more practical approach.
exampleTranslation: Kita membutuhkan pendekatan yang lebih praktis.

definition: suitable or right for a particular situation
example: That isn't an appropriate way to speak to a customer.
exampleTranslation: Itu bukan cara yang pantas untuk berbicara kepada pelanggan.

definition: to officially accept or agree with something
example: The manager approved my request.
exampleTranslation: Manajer menyetujui permintaanku.

definition: to speak angrily because you disagree
example: They often argue about money.
exampleTranslation: Mereka sering berdebat tentang uang.

definition: to organize or plan something
example: I'll arrange a meeting for next week.
exampleTranslation: Aku akan mengatur rapat untuk minggu depan.

definition: a plan or organization made in advance
example: Have you made any travel arrangements?
exampleTranslation: Apakah kamu sudah membuat pengaturan perjalanan?

definition: to help someone do something
example: A staff member will assist you with the form.
exampleTranslation: Seorang staf akan membantumu mengisi formulir.

definition: to believe something is true without proof
example: Don't assume that everyone knows the rules.
exampleTranslation: Jangan menganggap semua orang tahu aturannya.

definition: an effort to do something difficult
example: She made an attempt to contact him.
exampleTranslation: Dia berusaha menghubunginya.

definition: to go to an event, class, or meeting
example: I have to attend a training session tomorrow.
exampleTranslation: Aku harus menghadiri sesi pelatihan besok.

definition: the way you think or feel about something
example: A positive attitude can make a difference.
exampleTranslation: Sikap positif bisa membawa perubahan.

definition: to make someone interested in something
example: The job attracts people from different backgrounds.
exampleTranslation: Pekerjaan itu menarik orang dari berbagai latar belakang.

definition: able to be used, obtained, or reached
example: Is this room available tonight?
exampleTranslation: Apakah kamar ini tersedia malam ini?

definition: to stay away from something or prevent it from happening
example: Try to avoid making the same mistake.
exampleTranslation: Cobalah menghindari kesalahan yang sama.

definition: knowing that something exists or is happening
example: Are you aware of the changes?
exampleTranslation: Apakah kamu mengetahui perubahan itu?

definition: a state in which different things are equal or stable
example: It's important to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
exampleTranslation: Penting untuk menjaga keseimbangan kerja dan kehidupan.

definition: to act in a particular way
example: He behaved professionally during the meeting.
exampleTranslation: Dia berperilaku profesional selama rapat.

definition: an advantage or helpful effect
example: Regular reading has many benefits.
exampleTranslation: Membaca secara rutin memiliki banyak manfaat.

definition: to say someone is responsible for something bad
example: Don't blame yourself for everything.
exampleTranslation: Jangan menyalahkan dirimu sendiri atas semuanya.

definition: to annoy someone or make an effort to do something
example: Sorry to bother you, but I have a question.
exampleTranslation: Maaf mengganggu, tetapi aku punya pertanyaan.

definition: lasting only a short time or using few words
example: Let's have a brief conversation after lunch.
exampleTranslation: Mari bicara sebentar setelah makan siang.

definition: peaceful and not worried or excited
example: Take a deep breath and stay calm.
exampleTranslation: Tarik napas dalam-dalam dan tetap tenang.

definition: having the ability or qualities needed to do something
example: She's capable of handling the responsibility.
exampleTranslation: Dia mampu menangani tanggung jawab itu.

definition: the series of jobs you do during your working life
example: He's considering a career in education.
exampleTranslation: Dia sedang mempertimbangkan karier di bidang pendidikan.

definition: something difficult that tests your ability
example: Learning a new language is a rewarding challenge.
exampleTranslation: Mempelajari bahasa baru adalah tantangan yang memuaskan.

definition: an opportunity or possibility
example: Give yourself a chance to improve.
exampleTranslation: Beri dirimu kesempatan untuk berkembang.

definition: a fact or condition that affects a situation
example: Under the circumstances, we did our best.
exampleTranslation: Dalam keadaan seperti itu, kami sudah melakukan yang terbaik.

definition: to make something easier to understand
example: Could you clarify what you mean?
exampleTranslation: Bisakah kamu memperjelas maksudmu?

definition: feeling relaxed and free from pain or worry
example: I don't feel comfortable discussing that here.
exampleTranslation: Aku tidak nyaman membahas itu di sini.

definition: to share information, ideas, or feelings
example: It's important to communicate clearly.
exampleTranslation: Penting untuk berkomunikasi dengan jelas.

definition: to examine how two or more things are similar or different
example: Don't compare your progress with someone else's.
exampleTranslation: Jangan bandingkan perkembanganmu dengan orang lain.

definition: to try to be more successful than others
example: Small businesses often compete with larger companies.
exampleTranslation: Bisnis kecil sering bersaing dengan perusahaan besar.

definition: to say that something is wrong or unsatisfactory
example: Customers complained about the long waiting time.
exampleTranslation: Pelanggan mengeluhkan waktu tunggu yang lama.

definition: having many connected parts and being difficult to understand
example: The issue is more complex than it seems.
exampleTranslation: Masalah itu lebih rumit daripada kelihatannya.

definition: to give all your attention to something
example: I find it hard to concentrate when it's noisy.
exampleTranslation: Aku sulit berkonsentrasi ketika berisik.

definition: a feeling of worry or something that interests someone
example: Safety is our main concern.
exampleTranslation: Keselamatan adalah perhatian utama kami.

definition: feeling sure about your abilities or decisions
example: You sound more confident when you speak slowly.
exampleTranslation: Kamu terdengar lebih percaya diri saat berbicara perlahan.

definition: to say or show that something is definitely true
example: Please confirm your attendance by Friday.
exampleTranslation: Tolong konfirmasi kehadiranmu sebelum Jumat.

definition: to make someone unable to understand something
example: The instructions confused me at first.
exampleTranslation: Instruksi itu awalnya membuatku bingung.

definition: to think carefully about something before deciding
example: I'm considering changing my study routine.
exampleTranslation: Aku sedang mempertimbangkan untuk mengubah rutinitas belajarku.

definition: always behaving or happening in a similar way
example: Consistent practice matters more than occasional effort.
exampleTranslation: Latihan yang konsisten lebih penting daripada usaha sesekali.

definition: to have something inside or include something
example: This article contains useful information.
exampleTranslation: Artikel ini berisi informasi yang berguna.

definition: to keep doing something without stopping
example: Let's continue where we left off.
exampleTranslation: Mari lanjutkan dari bagian terakhir.

definition: to give something, such as time or effort, to help achieve something
example: Everyone can contribute to the discussion.
exampleTranslation: Semua orang bisa berkontribusi dalam diskusi.

definition: to make someone believe that something is true
example: I couldn't convince him to change his mind.
exampleTranslation: Aku tidak bisa meyakinkannya untuk mengubah pikirannya.

definition: to deal successfully with a difficult situation
example: She's learning how to cope with stress.
exampleTranslation: Dia sedang belajar cara mengatasi stres.

definition: to make something new
example: We need to create a better learning environment.
exampleTranslation: Kita perlu menciptakan lingkungan belajar yang lebih baik.

definition: eager to know or learn something
example: I'm curious about how the system works.
exampleTranslation: Aku penasaran bagaimana sistem itu bekerja.

definition: a choice that you make after thinking
example: It was a difficult decision to make.
exampleTranslation: Itu keputusan yang sulit untuk diambil.

definition: to politely refuse or become smaller or weaker
example: She declined the invitation politely.
exampleTranslation: Dia menolak undangan itu dengan sopan.

definition: to explain the meaning of a word or idea
example: It's difficult to define success in one sentence.
exampleTranslation: Sulit mendefinisikan kesuksesan dalam satu kalimat.

definition: a strong request or need for something
example: There is high demand for skilled workers.
exampleTranslation: Ada permintaan tinggi untuk pekerja terampil.

definition: to be decided or affected by something else
example: The result depends on how much effort you put in.
exampleTranslation: Hasilnya bergantung pada seberapa besar usahamu.

definition: to say what someone or something is like
example: Can you describe what happened?
exampleTranslation: Bisakah kamu menggambarkan apa yang terjadi?

definition: to have earned something because of your actions or qualities
example: You deserve a break after all that work.
exampleTranslation: Kamu pantas beristirahat setelah semua pekerjaan itu.

definition: to grow or make something grow or improve
example: I want to develop my speaking skills.
exampleTranslation: Aku ingin mengembangkan kemampuan berbicaraku.

definition: the way in which two or more things are not the same
example: There's a big difference between knowing and using a word.
exampleTranslation: Ada perbedaan besar antara mengetahui dan menggunakan sebuah kata.

definition: unhappy because something was not as good as expected
example: I was disappointed with the service.
exampleTranslation: Aku kecewa dengan pelayanannya.

definition: to find something for the first time or learn something surprising
example: I discovered a useful way to remember vocabulary.
exampleTranslation: Aku menemukan cara yang berguna untuk mengingat kosakata.

definition: to talk about something with another person or group
example: We need to discuss the next steps.
exampleTranslation: Kita perlu mendiskusikan langkah selanjutnya.

definition: producing the result that you want
example: Short, regular sessions are an effective way to learn.
exampleTranslation: Sesi singkat dan rutin adalah cara belajar yang efektif.

definition: physical or mental energy used to do something
example: Your effort will pay off over time.
exampleTranslation: Usahamu akan membuahkan hasil seiring waktu.

definition: to give someone support or confidence to do something
example: My friends encouraged me to keep practising.
exampleTranslation: Teman-temanku menyemangatiku untuk terus berlatih.

definition: the natural world or the conditions in which someone lives or works
example: A quiet environment helps me focus.
exampleTranslation: Lingkungan yang tenang membantuku fokus.

definition: completely necessary or extremely important
example: Practice is essential if you want to improve.
exampleTranslation: Latihan sangat diperlukan jika kamu ingin berkembang.

definition: to start an organization or create a system or rule
example: They established a new training programme.
exampleTranslation: Mereka membentuk program pelatihan baru.

definition: in the end, especially after a long time
example: After several attempts, she eventually succeeded.
exampleTranslation: Setelah beberapa percobaan, akhirnya dia berhasil.

definition: facts or information that show whether something is true
example: There isn't enough evidence to support the claim.
exampleTranslation: Tidak ada cukup bukti untuk mendukung klaim itu.

definition: knowledge or skill gained by doing something
example: Work experience can help you build confidence.
exampleTranslation: Pengalaman kerja dapat membantumu membangun kepercayaan diri.

definition: to make an idea or situation clear
example: Could you explain that in simpler terms?
exampleTranslation: Bisakah kamu menjelaskannya dengan istilah yang lebih sederhana?

definition: to communicate a thought or feeling
example: It's not always easy to express your feelings.
exampleTranslation: Tidak selalu mudah untuk mengungkapkan perasaanmu.

definition: well known to you or easily recognized
example: That expression sounds familiar.
exampleTranslation: Ungkapan itu terdengar tidak asing.

definition: the main point of interest or to give attention to something
example: Let's focus on the most important details.
exampleTranslation: Mari fokus pada detail yang paling penting.

definition: happening often
example: Frequent practice helps you remember new words.
exampleTranslation: Latihan yang sering membantumu mengingat kata baru.

definition: to become better or make something better
example: You can improve your English by using it every day.
exampleTranslation: Kamu bisa meningkatkan bahasa Inggrismu dengan menggunakannya setiap hari.

definition: the power to affect how someone thinks or behaves
example: Friends can influence the way we speak.
exampleTranslation: Teman dapat memengaruhi cara kita berbicara.

definition: to keep something at the same level or in good condition
example: It's hard to maintain motivation every day.
exampleTranslation: Sulit menjaga motivasi setiap hari.

definition: to control or organize something; to succeed in doing something
example: I managed to finish everything before noon.
exampleTranslation: Aku berhasil menyelesaikan semuanya sebelum tengah hari.

definition: to become aware of something
example: Did you notice the change in his voice?
exampleTranslation: Apakah kamu menyadari perubahan pada suaranya?

definition: a situation in which it is possible to do something
example: This job is a great opportunity to learn.
exampleTranslation: Pekerjaan ini adalah kesempatan bagus untuk belajar.

definition: to do an action or task; to entertain an audience
example: You need to perform well under pressure.
exampleTranslation: Kamu perlu bekerja dengan baik di bawah tekanan.

definition: to stop something from happening
example: A clear plan can prevent unnecessary mistakes.
exampleTranslation: Rencana yang jelas dapat mencegah kesalahan yang tidak perlu.

definition: used to say that something is likely
example: I'll probably stay home tonight.
exampleTranslation: Aku mungkin akan di rumah malam ini.

definition: to give someone something that they need
example: The website provides free learning materials.
exampleTranslation: Situs web itu menyediakan materi belajar gratis.

definition: to understand or become aware of something
example: I didn't realize how much time had passed.
exampleTranslation: Aku tidak sadar berapa banyak waktu yang sudah berlalu.

definition: to suggest that someone should do or use something
example: Would you recommend this book to beginners?
exampleTranslation: Apakah kamu akan merekomendasikan buku ini kepada pemula?

definition: to make something smaller or less
example: We need to reduce unnecessary spending.
exampleTranslation: Kita perlu mengurangi pengeluaran yang tidak perlu.

definition: able to be trusted or depended on
example: She's a reliable person to work with.
exampleTranslation: Dia orang yang bisa diandalkan untuk diajak bekerja.

definition: to need something or make it necessary
example: This position requires good communication skills.
exampleTranslation: Posisi ini membutuhkan kemampuan komunikasi yang baik.

definition: to say or do something as an answer or reaction
example: He didn't respond to my message.
exampleTranslation: Dia tidak membalas pesanku.

definition: having a duty to deal with something
example: You're responsible for your own progress.
exampleTranslation: Kamu bertanggung jawab atas perkembanganmu sendiri.

definition: something that happens because of an action or situation
example: The result was better than we expected.
exampleTranslation: Hasilnya lebih baik daripada yang kami perkirakan.

definition: to offer an idea or plan for someone to consider
example: I suggest taking a short break.
exampleTranslation: Aku menyarankan untuk beristirahat sebentar.

definition: to help or encourage someone or something
example: Thanks for supporting me throughout the process.
exampleTranslation: Terima kasih sudah mendukungku sepanjang proses ini.

definition: to be likely to behave or happen in a particular way
example: I tend to forget names.
exampleTranslation: Aku cenderung lupa nama orang.

definition: worth a lot of money or very useful
example: Your feedback is valuable to us.
exampleTranslation: Masukanmu sangat berharga bagi kami.

definition: several different types of something
example: The course covers various topics.
exampleTranslation: Kursus itu mencakup berbagai topik.

definition: ready or happy to do something
example: I'm willing to help if you need me.
exampleTranslation: Aku bersedia membantu kalau kamu membutuhkanku.
